crossRefs.note: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors…
Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some…
Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
“Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on…
Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them…
I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation…
The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity; because they trespassed against…
I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.
I won’t hide my face from them any more; for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because…

translations.web: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
translations.bsb: But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
translations.kjv: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
translations.asv: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, so that he will not hear.
